original_value: Orchid Vale Aurora Lamp 27Q is a fictional 27-inch QHD desktop monitor designed for illustration and concept studios. It features a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 75Hz refresh rate, 99% sRGB coverage, and a fully adjustable stand with USB-C input, DisplayPort, and HDMI connectivity. The display is intended for general productivity, color-sensitive work, and casual entertainment rather than gaming or storage use.
